name: SignInBlock
title: Sign In
summary: A sign-in section: email and password that validate on submit, Sign in with Apple, and creating an account in the same block.
description: Email and password with real autofill, a show and hide toggle and validation on submit. One Sign in button runs your async sign in through working, done and failed, and Sign in with Apple and creating an account sit in the same block.
parts: Sign in button with its states

name: AccountSettingsBlock
title: Account Settings
summary: The account section at the top of Settings: profile, appearance, notifications, your data, sign out and deleting the account.
description: The account section every app needs. Your profile with its photo, appearance and notification preferences bound to your app's own values, exporting your data, and signing out or deleting the account behind a calm confirmation.

name: PlanUsageBlock
title: Plan and Usage
summary: The subscription section of Settings: the current plan, what has been used of it, and the way up.
description: Where a subscriber checks their plan. The plan sits on a solid card with its price and renewal date; usage meters below fill to what has been used and warn as one nears its limit; upgrading, managing the subscription in the App Store and restoring a purchase are one tap each.
parts: Current plan card with its renewal
Usage meters that warn near a limit

name: InviteFriendsBlock
title: Invite Friends
summary: A referral section: the reward and how close you are, your invite code to copy or share, and who joined.
description: A referral section that pays for itself. A reward track fills a seat for each friend who joins; the invite code copies with one tap and shares through the system share sheet; invited friends list below with where each one is, from invited to joined.
parts: Reward track that fills per friend

name: StatsOverviewBlock
title: Stats Overview
summary: The top of an analytics screen: a headline metric you scrub across ranges, the tiles beside it, and its loading and retry states.
description: One headline metric with its change against the last period, on a chart you scrub to read any day. Switch the range and the line redraws; secondary metrics sit in tiles below, and loading, empty and failed states come designed.

name: CheckoutBlock
title: Checkout
summary: A checkout section: the bag with quantities, delivery, a promo code, the total, Apple Pay and one Pay button through to the placed order.
description: The bag with quantities you change in place, the delivery address and speed, a promo code and a total that follows every change. Pay with Apple Pay or the saved card; one Pay button runs your order through working, done and the placed confirmation.
